description: Who deployed a Solana token and what else that wallet deployed, with each token's outcome (active, inactive, dead, liquidity removed, by stated on-chain rules) and any linked GitHub or X accounts. Every claim has a tier (verified, corroborated, claimed, unknown) and a public evidence URL with the time it was read. An address not tracked yet is queued for a lookup and answered as unknown. Facts with sources, never a verdict about a person. Free.

query.description: A Solana wallet or mint address, github:<user>, or x:<handle> (or @handle)

name: dev_lookup
title: Solana deployer lookup (sourced)
